indicators.name: adx
indicators.doc: Average Directional Index — trend strength regardless of direction. Candle-fed.

indicators.name: anchored_return
indicators.doc: Return since the open of the current `bucketMinutes` UTC-grid cell, resetting each bucket. Bind on a fine stream (1m) with a coarser bucket (30) to read the forming coarse bar's intra-bar move, e.g. `beta(gbp.close, eur.close, n) * anchored_return(gbp.candle, 30) - anchored_return(eur.candle, 30)`.

indicators.name: atr
indicators.doc: Average True Range (volatility). Pass the stream, not a field — it needs high/low/close.

indicators.name: beta
indicators.doc: Beta of the series against a benchmark series over the window.

indicators.name: bollinger_lower
indicators.doc: Lower Bollinger band: SMA minus stddev standard deviations.

indicators.name: bollinger_middle
indicators.doc: Middle Bollinger band: the SMA over the window.

indicators.name: bollinger_upper
indicators.doc: Upper Bollinger band: SMA plus stddev standard deviations.

indicators.name: cci
indicators.doc: Commodity Channel Index — deviation from the typical-price moving average. Candle-fed.

indicators.name: confirm_ratio
indicators.doc: Fraction of peer series whose return over `lookback` bars matches the signal's direction, in [0,1]. Negate a peer (`-usdchf.close`) to flip polarity for inverse pairs.

indicators.name: correlation
indicators.doc: Pearson correlation between two series over the window, in [-1, 1].

indicators.name: dema
indicators.doc: Double exponential moving average. Less lag than EMA at the same period.

indicators.name: ema
indicators.doc: Exponential moving average. Weights recent bars more; reacts faster than SMA.

indicators.name: er
indicators.doc: Kaufman Efficiency Ratio over `period` bars, in [0,1]: net move divided by total path length. Near 1 is a clean trend, near 0 is chop. Gate momentum on high ER, stand down on low.

indicators.name: failed_break_high
indicators.doc: 1 for `armBars` bars after the high of the prior `rangeLen` bars is pierced and then a bar within `reclaimBars` closes back inside — a trapped-breakout fakeout. A pierce that keeps closing outside is a real break and never arms.

indicators.name: failed_break_low
indicators.doc: The downside mirror of `failed_break_high`: 1 for `armBars` bars after the prior-`rangeLen` low is pierced and reclaimed (a bar closes back above it) within `reclaimBars`.

indicators.name: gap_fill_fraction
indicators.doc: How far price has retraced from the reopen open back toward the gap origin, in gap units: 0 at the reopen, 1 at a full fill. Gate a continuation on a non-fill, e.g. `< 0.5`.

indicators.name: highest
indicators.doc: Highest value over the `period` bars BEFORE the current one (excludes the evaluating bar).

indicators.name: hma
indicators.doc: Hull moving average. Low lag and smooth, built from weighted moving averages.

indicators.name: ib_defended_high
indicators.doc: 1 once the session's Initial-Balance high (high of the first `ibMinutes` from `sessionStartHour` UTC) has been tested and held — a bar traded through it but closed back inside — earlier this session; else 0. Resets daily. Pair with `session_range_high`.

indicators.name: ib_defended_low
indicators.doc: The downside mirror of `ib_defended_high`: 1 once the session's Initial-Balance low has been tested and held earlier this session. Resets daily. Pair with `session_range_low`.

indicators.name: keltner_lower
indicators.doc: Lower Keltner channel: EMA minus atr_mult times ATR.

indicators.name: keltner_middle
indicators.doc: Middle Keltner channel: the EMA of the typical price.

indicators.name: keltner_upper
indicators.doc: Upper Keltner channel: EMA plus atr_mult times ATR.

indicators.name: lag
indicators.doc: The value of the series n bars ago — a pure time offset. Build a skip-window return like `lag(close, 21) - lag(close, 252)` to measure a trend that ends 21 bars in the past. Null until n+1 bars seen.

indicators.name: lowest
indicators.doc: Lowest value over the `period` bars BEFORE the current one (excludes the evaluating bar).

indicators.name: macd
indicators.doc: MACD line: fast EMA minus slow EMA. Common settings (12, 26, 9).

indicators.name: macd_hist
indicators.doc: MACD histogram: MACD line minus signal line.

indicators.name: macd_signal
indicators.doc: MACD signal line: the EMA of the MACD line over `signal` bars.

indicators.name: minus_di
indicators.doc: -DI, the negative directional indicator of the ADX system. Candle-fed.

indicators.name: obv
indicators.doc: On-Balance Volume — running volume total signed by each bar's direction. Candle-fed.

indicators.name: percentile_rank
indicators.doc: Fraction of the trailing `lookback` window strictly below the current value, in [0,1). Distribution-free regime gate — separates a bimodal series where zscore cannot.

indicators.name: pivot_p
indicators.doc: Central floor-trader pivot `(high + low + close) / 3` of the prior completed UTC day, held through the current day. The most-watched intraday mean-reversion magnet.

indicators.name: pivot_r1
indicators.doc: First resistance pivot `2 * pivot_p - prior_day_low`, from the prior completed UTC day. A protective stop above a pivot fade sits just beyond this level.

indicators.name: pivot_s1
indicators.doc: First support pivot `2 * pivot_p - prior_day_high`, from the prior completed UTC day. A protective stop below a pivot fade sits just beyond this level.

indicators.name: plus_di
indicators.doc: +DI, the positive directional indicator of the ADX system. Candle-fed.

indicators.name: regression_slope
indicators.doc: Slope of the least-squares line fitted over the window — trend direction and steepness.

indicators.name: reopen_gap
indicators.doc: Signed price gap opened across a trading break longer than `minGapHours` (the weekend): the reopen open minus the last close before the break. Latched at the reopen, held until the next one. Size it against `atr` to isolate large gaps.

indicators.name: reopen_gap_origin
indicators.doc: The pre-break close a full fill of the reopen gap returns to — use as a protective-stop price level for a gap-continuation trade. Companion to `reopen_gap` / `gap_fill_fraction`.

indicators.name: resid
indicators.doc: Latest residual of a rolling OLS fit of the dependent series on its regressors — the part of the dependent the regressors don't explain. Compose with zscore to fade idiosyncratic moves.

indicators.name: rsi
indicators.doc: Relative Strength Index, bounded 0-100. Below 30 oversold, above 70 overbought.

indicators.name: runlength
indicators.doc: Signed length of the current same-direction run: +k after k consecutive rises, -k after k consecutive falls, 0 when the last change was flat (a flat value breaks the run). No lookback — the streak accumulates from the last direction change. Null until one prior value.

indicators.name: runlength_where
indicators.doc: Consecutive-bar dwell counter for a boolean condition: increments while the condition is true and resets to 0 when false. Use it for state-duration filters such as calm-volatility dwell.

indicators.name: seasonal_range
indicators.doc: Trailing mean realized range (high - low) of the last `window` bars sharing the current bar's UTC hour — a per-hour vol baseline. Divide the bar's range by it for an excess-vol ratio that flags shock vol, not clock vol. Null until `window` bars of that hour are seen.

indicators.name: seasonal_range_stdev
indicators.doc: Trailing sample standard deviation of realized range (high - low) across the last `window` bars sharing the current bar's UTC hour — the dispersion companion to `seasonal_range`. Use `((high - low) - seasonal_range(...)) / seasonal_range_stdev(...)` for an hour-relative z-score. Needs `window` > 1; null until `window` bars of that hour are seen.

indicators.name: session_momentum
indicators.doc: Cumulative within-window simple return summed over the last `nDays` completed days, using only bars inside `[startHour, endHour)` UTC. Isolates the informative session's drift from off-hours noise. Null until `nDays` in-window days complete.

indicators.name: session_range_high
indicators.doc: High of the most recent completed instance of the daily UTC window, held as a constant level until the next instance completes. Wraps midnight when start is after end.

indicators.name: session_range_low
indicators.doc: Low of the most recent completed instance of the daily UTC window, held as a constant level until the next instance completes. Wraps midnight when start is after end.

indicators.name: skew
indicators.doc: Rolling realized skewness of bar-to-bar returns over the last `period` returns — the third standardized moment. Negative means crash-prone (sharp drops); positive means lottery-like (sharp jumps up). Measures asymmetry that stddev cannot.

indicators.name: sma
indicators.doc: Simple moving average. Equal weighting over the window; smooth but slower.

indicators.name: stddev
indicators.doc: Rolling sample standard deviation over the window.

indicators.name: stoch_d
indicators.doc: Stochastic %D — the smoothed (signal) line of %K. Candle-fed.

indicators.name: stoch_k
indicators.doc: Stochastic %K — close relative to the recent high/low range. Candle-fed.

indicators.name: tema
indicators.doc: Triple exponential moving average. Even less lag than DEMA.

indicators.name: variance
indicators.doc: Rolling sample variance over the window (standard deviation squared).

indicators.name: variance_ratio
indicators.doc: Lo-MacKinlay variance ratio over `lookback` bars: variance of overlapping k-bar return sums divided by k times the 1-bar return variance. ~1 random walk, <1 mean-reverting, >1 trending. Null until lookback+1 bars seen or when the 1-bar variance is zero.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.doc: Volume-weighted average price over the last `period` ticks. Tick-fed: pass `<alias>.tick`.

indicators.name: vwap_session
indicators.doc: Session-anchored volume-weighted average price, reset each day at `anchorHour` UTC. Pass the stream — it needs volume.

indicators.name: vwap_session_stdev
indicators.doc: Volume-weighted standard deviation of price around the session VWAP — build bands as `vwap_session(s, h) ± k * vwap_session_stdev(s, h)`.

indicators.name: williams_r
indicators.doc: Williams %R momentum oscillator, bounded -100 to 0. Candle-fed.

indicators.name: wma
indicators.doc: Weighted moving average. Linear weights — recent bars count more than SMA, less than EMA.

indicators.name: zscore
indicators.doc: Standardized distance of the value from its rolling mean, in standard deviations.
